• Implemented and committed 7613a8048 fix:
  parametric loop cuts.

  - Face-mode authored quads now cut at equal
    edge fractions; the plane-normal comb no
    longer drives quad geometry.

  - Edge-ring mode uses the same parametric
    core at t=0.5.

  - Non-quad/partial selections retain the
    existing fallback and emit a status log.

  - Added parametric quad cuts hit equal
    fractions on sheared opposite edges,
    asserting endpoints at t=0.25 and t=0.75.

  tools/mesh-port-parity

  It replays real native ops on sheared, non-square,

resolution: Reviewed the 6-lane fix pass (7 commits). Ran tools/mesh-port-parity for ground truth: 2/9 rows PASS, contradicting T5's 'parity passed including loopcut' claim. Verdicts: ACCEPTED T1 modifier bridge (f5cc536d5+wiring; clean shared sdlModifiers.ts, only WorldViewport consumes pointer mods — no surprise wake-ups; in-app shift-click gesture still needs the user's hands), T2 facade scope+side (d159264e1; gatherFacade deleted, req_3062 enforced, clicked-face side threaded), T3 facade alpha (aeaba9287; rides the painted-glass transparent route, unit-tested, visual check pending; commit also carries T1 runtime wiring — braided history noted), T4 solidify identities + merge dissolve (ff0691c34/f3128485e; correct, merge passes parity on closed fixtures). T6 harness accepted with two expected-side bugs found: JS edgeContract ignores naked border edges (explains the exact +3 on both bridge-fixture rows — false alarms) and solidify geometry expects TS averaged-normal offsets where the plane solver is the req_2932-ruled behavior. BOUNCED T5 loop cut (7613a8048): parametric primitive right, edge mode right, but face mode cuts ONLY the selected quad — the cut no longer propagates around the ring (7 groups vs contract 10 on every fixture) — a subdivide, not a loop cut. Follow-ups proposed to user: T5 ring-propagation rework + T6 contract fixes.
